What it is

A challenge built around real safety habits

This is not a gimmick. Students earn points by using the core Obserc features that already help friends look out for each other on nights out. Check ins, nudges, Night Out sessions, and itinerary use all feed directly into leaderboard performance.

The first edition runs exclusively at MTU Kerry, in partnership with MTU Kerry Student Union. Campus-exclusive, easy to explain, and native to student life in Tralee.

A student who starts and completes a Night Out session is far more likely to keep using Obserc long term. This challenge is designed to create that deeper usage pattern, fast.

MTU Kerry Exclusive Cash Prizes Real Safety Actions Student Union Backed

Points system

Simple to understand. Hard to fake.

Scoring rewards the behaviours that matter most. Night Out is weighted highest because it creates the deepest safety engagement.

How points are earned

Send a check in45 minute gap rule between same two users
+2 pts
Respond to a check inKeeps the loop mutual and active
+1 pt
Send a nudgeQuick proactive welfare check on a mate
+3 pts
Start a Night Out sessionHighest weighted action in the system
+10 pts
Add itinerary to Night OutAdd structure to the evening plan
+5 pts
Complete a Night OutRewards full feature completion
+5 pts
Daily cap per user: 40 points. Keeps competition healthy and pushes circles to rely on broad participation, not one power user.

Circle size multiplier

Circle scores sum all members daily points, then apply a multiplier based on how many were active that day.

2 active members1.0x
3 active members1.1x
4 active members1.2x
5 active members1.3x
6 active members1.4x
7+ active members1.5x cap
Active means earning 5+ points that day. Designed to reward consistent group participation, not one person carrying the squad.

The details

Fair, transparent, built to last.

Verification and privacy

Student ID verification is manual and temporary

Every entrant must verify with an MTU Kerry student ID. Reviews are handled manually to keep the challenge fair and the community protected.

  • Student IDs are reviewed once to confirm eligibility
  • IDs are deleted within 48 hours of verification
  • Only verified MTU Kerry students can enter the leaderboard
Anti-exploit rules

Built to discourage farming and late score manipulation

  • 45 minute gap rule for check ins between the same two users prevents reciprocal farming
  • Any circle whose Week 4 score jumps more than 40% above its Weeks 1 to 3 average is flagged for manual review before payout
  • Larger circles have a mathematical advantage through the multiplier and that is intentional, clearly disclosed in the terms
For Obserc
  • Creates a structured, time-limited reason to download the app on a new campus
  • Pushes users into Night Out Mode, the deepest and most valuable product behaviour
  • Drives circle formation and real feature adoption instead of shallow installs
For students
  • Cash prizes attached to behaviour students already do when they care about their mates
  • The 1,000 euro monthly prize is big enough to travel by word of mouth without a paid acquisition budget
  • Safety becomes social, habitual, and part of campus culture instead of an afterthought
